award_nyks_desc: Awarded by Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan under the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports for social service and eco-system initiatives. Honored as a 'Corona Warrior' during the Covid-19 pandemic (2020). Also received Best Youth Club Award (2021).
award_mt_desc: Honored with the 'Animuthyam State Award – 2020' for outstanding contribution to youth development and social service.
award_apj_title: Dr. A.P.J Abdul Kalam Memorial Award
award_apj_desc: Received the 'Seva Bhushan State Award – 2020' for dedicated service towards society and youth empowerment.
academy_desc: Ganesh Defence Academy was officially registered on 23rd December 2014 with Registration No: 488, under the name Ganesh Defence Association & Martial Arts Association. The academy is committed to preparing disciplined, confident and job-ready candidates for defence and uniformed services.
contact_desc: Ready to start your journey at our Defence Academy? Our team is here to guide you 24/7.
